sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disables every partner ad-SDK initializer TextNow runs (Facebook Audience Network, Amazon, Fyber/DT Exchange, InMobi, Nimbus, LiveRamp, The Trade Desk) at its own isEnabled() gate, so no ad SDK ever initialises.
Disables Firebase measurement, the AppsFlyer install-referrer provider and Facebook auto-init components, and sets the Firebase/GA/Facebook collection opt-outs. FCM push is kept.
No-ops AppsFlyer's implementation entry points (start, logEvent) so the attribution SDK never starts and no attribution or analytics event is sent.
Disables every ad-network component TextNow declares (Facebook Audience Network, Amazon APS/DTB) and strips the ad-ID / ad-services / install-referrer permissions.
